caption: The drawing depicts a wooden sideboard or cabinet with an upper and lower section. The cabinet is primarily brown, with the wood grain visible throughout the structure. The upper section consists of two doors, each with a glass panel in the upper half and a rectangular wooden panel below the glass. The sides of the upper section also have light-colored square inlays. The lower section features three drawers with round handles—two smaller drawers side by side and one larger drawer beneath them. There is a flat surface between the upper and lower sections, with brass or gold-colored fittings at the corners. The side panels of the lower section also have a lighter rectangular inlay that matches those in the upper section. The cabinet stands on four straight legs and is placed against a plain, light-colored background. There is a small signature in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Secretary Bookcase
